lines.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

data.define: Short for "as soon as possible"; used to ask for something quickly.

example.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

misuse.text: Don't write 'ASAP' to your boss rudely.

data.l1: dès que possible; au plus vite; le plus tôt possible
data.l1_hook: J'en ai besoin tout de suite, « ASAP » !

native.tip: “ASAP” = dès que possible; au plus vite; le plus tôt possible. Exemple: “Please send me the notes ASAP.”
